anchors.name: Hakone-Yumoto Station and shopping street
anchors.note: OSM station node (Nominatim). Also near Hakone Yuryo onsen. Shops close early; after ~19:00 only a handful of places are open.

anchors.name: Gora Station / Gora Park / Hakone Tozan cable car
anchors.note: OSM station node. Miyanoshita bakeries (Picot, Watanabe) are ~1.2 km down the line.

anchors.name: Owakudani Station (Hakone Ropeway)
anchors.note: OSM station node. Food only inside the station building / Kurotamago-kan complex, roughly 09:00-16:30; nothing open in the evening. Togendai (end of ropeway) is 2+ km away and not covered.

anchors.name: Moto-Hakone port and Lake Ashi lakefront (Hakone Shrine street)
anchors.note: OSM Motohakone Port ferry terminal. Hakone Shrine is ~0.5 km. Hakone Sekisho (Hakone-machi) is ~1.6 km south and not covered. The famous Amazake-chaya is at Hatajuku, ~5 km away, so it is NOT included.

anchors.name: Haneda Airport Terminal 3 (International)
anchors.jp: 羽田空港第3ターミナル
anchors.note: OSM T3 station node. Covers 4F Edo Koji (Edo Market Place), 3F departures lobby, 5F Tokyo Poptown and Haneda Airport Garden. Airside (post-security 3F) venues flagged in notes.

anchors.name: Narita Airport Terminal 1 (Air China departs T1 South Wing 4F)
anchors.jp: 成田空港第1ターミナル
anchors.note: OSM T1 terminal node. Air China = Terminal 1 South Wing 4F per narita-airport.jp/en/flight/airline-search/cca/. Landside (4F/5F, before security) and airside (3F, after security) both listed; airside flagged in notes.

venues.name: Hatsu Hana Honten (yam soba)

venues.notes: Hakonenavi (2020 article) said open to 03:00; Tabelog says 23:00 - Tabelog used. Closed Wed/Thu. Small, may be hard for 4.

venues.name: Gora Brewery Public House

venues.name: Hakone Tenku no Terrace (cafe)

venues.name: Watanabe Bakery
